text.tspan: SQSO-HW-DIAG-001 · preliminary · dashed = part not selected (TBD) · TBR = value not confirmed
Sources: software/rust/firmware/src/adc.rs (FRONT_END, pins TBR); docs/BASELINE_PARAMETERS.md 5 (4S pack); hardware/eps/PDU_DESIGN.md (ranges)
1:6, 16.8 V reads 2.8 V. The firmware's FRONT_END says 1:3 (a 2S value, 8.4 V max):
a 4S pack on a 1:3 divider would put 5.6 V on PC2. Change adc.rs to Linear(6.0, 0) with
this divider (finding F1). Divider draws 140 uA from the pack: gate it or raise R (TBR).
0.5 V/A, 1.65 V at 0 A: adc.rs Linear(2.0, -3.3).
1:4, as adc.rs. Two-cell strings, Voc about 5.4 V, read 1.35 V
(TBR: the divider could be 1:2 for resolution).
10 mV/C, 0.5 V at 0 C: adc.rs Linear(100, -50). The TMP117 (S3) also
measures the board; one of the two may go (TBR).
